10-Minute Leftover Beef Kebab Tacos

10-min street taco lunch built from 3 leftover Costco beef kebabs. Chain-cook from Freezer Shortcut Beef Kebab Pitas (id 54).

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIME10 min
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~450 cal | ~38g protein

Ingredients

Ingredients

  • 3 fully cooked Mediterranean beef kebabs (The Falafel Company at Costco — verify halal on the current physical package)
  • 3 low-carb street taco flour tortillas (La Banderita Carb Counter shown)
  • Pickled red onions, as desired
  • 3 tsp Tari hot sauce, optional (~1 tsp per taco, any preferred flavor)

You have leftover Costco beef kebabs from Freezer Shortcut Beef Kebab Pitas (id 54) and want a fast workday lunch. 10 min from fridge to plate, 38g protein at 450 cal for three street tacos.

Method

  1. 1.THAW. Thaw the fully cooked beef kebabs overnight in the refrigerator.
  2. 2.AIR-FRY. Reheat kebabs 7-8 min at the temperature on the current package, until thoroughly hot. Physical package directions take priority.
  3. 3.WARM TORTILLAS. Warm the 3 street tortillas per package directions (or skip if you like them cold).
  4. 4.ADD KEBABS. Place one reheated kebab on each tortilla.
  5. 5.PICKLED ONION. Top each taco with pickled red onions.
  6. 6.TARI DRIZZLE (optional). Finish with ~1 tsp Tari hot sauce per taco, or skip the sauce. Serve immediately.

Storage and reheating

Store: Follow the beef-kebab package for refrigerated storage and reheating guidance. Assemble tacos immediately before eating for the best tortilla texture.

Reheat: Air-fry the kebabs per package. Don't microwave assembled tacos — turns the tortilla into a wet dishcloth.

Lasts: Reheat only the kebabs needed for this lunch. Assembled tacos don't hold — the tortilla softens fast.

Estimated nutrition

~450 cal | ~38g protein.

450 cal / 38g protein per serving (3 tacos) — user-provided complete-lunch macros. Component reference: 3 Falafel Company beef kebabs (~285 cal / 24P at typical package labels — verify current package) + 3 La Banderita Carb Counter tortillas (~150 cal / 15P) + pickled red onions (~10 cal) + 3 tsp Tari sauce (~5-10 cal). Brands I use

The Falafel Company
Fully Cooked Mediterranean Beef Kebabs (Costco freezer aisle)
Same freezer shortcut as Freezer Shortcut Beef Kebab Pitas (id 54). Fully cooked, air-fry 7-8 min from thawed. Verify halal + allergens on the current physical package — formulations can drift.
La Banderita
Carb Counter Street Taco Tortillas (~50 cal / 5g protein / 4g net carbs per tortilla)
Low-carb street-taco tortilla that softens well without going rubbery when warmed. 3 tortillas per lunch = ~150 cal / 15g protein from the shell alone. Same tortilla used on Leftover Cheeseburger Tacos.
Tari
Hot Sauce (optional, ~1 tsp per taco)
My current personal favorite hot sauce line — flavor-forward without going molten. Optional; the tacos still work without sauce or with a preferred substitute. Not sponsored, not affiliated.
